title: Monotonicity of e^{Λρ}ρ^{−n}μ(B_ρ(y)) with one constant Λ for all members of 𝓜 (property (5); conditional on (IM), (MON), (MB))
statement: Assume (IM) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency im_mass_measure, which is the selected node's first leading hypothesis: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every IMRep R of T in U: (a) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W ⊆ U; (b) for x ∈ U, x ∈ spt T if and only if R.measure(B_ε(x)) ≠ 0 for every ε > 0; (c) R′.measure = R.measure for every IMRep R′ of T in U. Assume (MON) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency monotonicity (the selected node's second leading hypothesis): for all P, n, d ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n ≤ d ≤ P, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold N with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅ and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0: (i) for every compact K ⊆ U there is Λ ≥ 0 such that ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is monotone on (0, R) whenever B̄_R(y) ⊆ K; (ii) if N = ℝ^P, then ρ ↦ ofReal(1/ρⁿ)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is monotone on (0, R) whenever B_R(y) ⊆ U; (iii) there is Θ, upper semicontinuous on U, with HasMassDensity T y (Θ y) for all y ∈ U; (iv) every density of T at a point of spt T is ≥ 1. Assume (MB) — the frozen type of the grandparent's registered dependency moving_blowups (the selected node's third leading hypothesis): for all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k, U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with 1 ≤ n, U open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold, (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T minimizing in U ∩ N, spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U, and for all x ∈ U, x_j → x and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0, there are a strictly increasing φ and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) such that blowUp T x_{φ(j)} λ_{φ(j)} ⇀ C in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly), MassMeasuresConverge holds for the same sequence, C is minimizing in ℝ^{n+k} and ∂C = 0. Let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and 1 ≤ n, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} be open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U. Let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and r > 0 with B̄_{2r}(z) ⊆ U, and let RT be an IMRep of T in U; write μ_T := RT.measure, W := B_{2r}(z) and η_{a,t} := dilation a t (η_{a,t}(v) = t⁻¹(v − a)). Let 𝓜 be a set of measures on ℝ^{n+k} such that μ ∈ 𝓜 if and only if either (PS) μ = ofReal(t⁻¹ⁿ) • (μ_T⌞W).map η_{a,t} for some a ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and some t with 0 < t ≤ r and dist(a, z) ≤ r − t; or (ZS) μ = RS.measure for some S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}) and some IMRep RS of S in ℝ^{n+k} for which there are points c_i, scales t_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) and a point b with dist(c_i, z) < r − t_i for every i, t_i → 0, c_i → b, and blowUp T c_i t_i ⇀ S in ℝ^{n+k} (ConvergesWeakly). (These are the selected node's positive-scale members μ_{x,λ} and zero-scale members, with (a, t) = (z + rx, rλ), c_i = z + rx_i, t_i = rλ_i, b = z + rx̄.) Then there is Λ ∈ ℝ such that for every μ ∈ 𝓜, every y ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and every R ∈ ℝ with B̄_R(y) ⊆ B̄_2(0), the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρⁿ)·μ(B_ρ(y)) is monotone (nondecreasing) on the open interval (0, R).
